Name: Minecraft Mobs as Rarecrows
Author: SGEzlo
Description:
This is a pretty basic mod for Stardew Valley. Using Content Patcher, it replaces four of the Rarecrows into Minecraft mobs, specifically the Enderman, Blaze, Wither Skeleton, and the Snow Golem. I made the models myself and I designed them in a way that makes them blend in well with Stardew Valley.

How to Install:
1. Download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
2. Download the mod.
3. Unzip the mod to your mod folder.

Downloads.Description: Main mod, requires Content Patcher and SMAPI
